text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert - high crashloop rate on runtime pods in us-west-2. Multiple containers restarting with SIGSEGV in custom fused kernel (vLLM/TensorRT path). Autoresolve suppressed.
sam: jumping in, oncall here. which pool? any customer impact yet?
priya: GPU pool gpu-pool-3 is flapping. k8s shows CrashLoopBackOff across 6 pods. CPU fallback attempts also show degraded latency.
jamie: logs from one pod attached, short tail below.
jamie: ```
[2026-03-17T02:03:41Z] runtime: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f1c1234acdb sp 0x7ffd8aa0
#0 0x7f1c1234acdb in fused_attn_kernel::compute()+0x12b
#1 0x7f1c1229b11a in vllm::runtime::execute_layer()+0x8a
#2 0x564d3f2a1ef0 in worker_loop()+0x1f0
Received signal SIGSEGV (11), code=SEGV_MAPERR.
Core dumped: /var/log/pods/runtime/core-<pod>.gz
```
sam: thanks. any pattern? only certain model variants or all requests?
priya: spikes correlate with requests to model: redwood/gpt-large-quantized-fused. Non-fused variant (no custom kernel) seems stable.
oncall-next: I'm on it. gonna cordon the affected nodes to stop creating more evictions and start draining.
ops-runner: starting cordon/drain now: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-5-32` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data ip-10-0-5-32`
priya: +1. also increasing allocation to fallback CPU pool for critical customers.
jamie: quick mitigation: set env VAR `REDWOOD_FUSED_KERNEL=0` in deployment to disable fused kernels and force fallback to generic kernels. rolling restart of runtime pods.
deploy-bot: rollout started for runtime-deployment@us-west-2 (image: runtime:2026.03.15-hotfix). progress: 0/12 pods updated.
sam: good plan. Priya, can you confirm affected customers? customer-liaison, can you prepare comms for impacted accounts?
customer-liaison: seeing elevated 5xx rates for accounts: acme-inc, travellytics, and edu-sandbox. Severity: degraded for acme-inc (SLO breached for 3 min). Preparing short status note.
priya: impact summary: ~4% traffic getting 5xx across the region, acme-inc saw retries and timeouts. We'll enable CPU fallback for their routing to reduce errors.
oncall-next: drain in progress. will keep one node cordoned while we monitor. also collecting core dumps to GCS: `gsutil cp /var/log/pods/runtime/core-<pod>.gz gs://redwood-prod-cores/4778881234/`.
jamie: core traceback indicates null deref inside kernel when KV cache size > 128MB and sequence len > 2048. suspect cache indexing bug in fused kernel under long-seq workloads.
sam: ok assign: jamie owns triage + root-cause, priya owns mitigation/traffic, oncall-next owns live operations and customer updates. escalate if we see new SIGSEGV after disabling fused kernel.
ops-runner: rollout shows 9/12 pods restarted with env VAR applied, crashloops dropped to 0 on restarted pods. cluster CPU usage up but within limits.
customer-liaison: status update posted to customers: "We identified a runtime kernel issue causing instability for some GPU-backed deployments. We have applied a temporary mitigation that disables the fused kernel and rerouted some traffic. We're monitoring."
sam: great. capture timeline in incident tracker and tag eng-ml for a hotfix PR for the kernel bounds check.
jamie: creating draft PR to add guard and unit test. also will add a runtime flag gating large-KV flows until kernel is validated.
priya: recommend blocking model rollout for redwood/gpt-large-quantized-fused until kernel fix lands and we run canary on dedicated pool.
sam: agreed. set rollback policy to prevent that variant from being routed automatically.
oncall-next: handing off to next oncall @sam (ending shift). leave notes: cores uploaded, cordon on ip-10-0-5-32, fused disabled via env var, customer comms posted.
sam: ack handoff. will follow up with postmortem owners and schedule a blameless RCA for tomorrow.
incident-bot: incident channel created: #incident-4778881234. Postmortem checklist assigned.
customer-liaison: will follow up with impacted customers with ETA once jamie has an initial fix test plan (expect update in ~4 hours).
priya: monitoring shows 5xx back to baseline and tail latency stabilized. marking incident as mitigated, but not resolved until kernel patch.
sam: thanks everyone. follow-ups: upload core symbolication, PR review, canary plan, update runbook to include fused kernel kill-switch steps.
jamie: noted. adding unit/regression tests and a canary harness run for long-seq KV scenarios.
ops-runner: leaving logs and core references in incident doc: gs://redwood-prod-cores/4778881234/ and cloud-logs link.
sam: closing live pager for now. if we see any regression re-open immediately. :thumbsup:"
